formulation.title: Formulation
formulation.card: Buffer screening, excipient selection and compounding that make a product stable before it ever reaches a vial.
formulation.headline: A stable product starts with the right formulation.
formulation.lede: Our scientists screen buffers, stabilizers and bulking agents against your stability targets, then scale the recipe into GMP compounding with the same team.
caps: Pre-formulation screening
pH, ionic strength and excipient panels show what keeps your active stable and what harms it.
Lyophilization-ready design
We pick bulking agents and lyoprotectants that give a high collapse temperature and an elegant cake.
GMP compounding
Validated mixing vessels and sterile filtration take the final recipe from bench to batch size.
specBody: Every study is designed around the release and stability specs you will file.
Compounding records carry straight into the fill and lyophilization batch record.

reagent-manufacturing.title: Reagent Manufacturing
reagent-manufacturing.card: Diagnostic and research reagents made to your specification, from enzyme mixes to custom buffers and controls.
reagent-manufacturing.headline: Reagents made to your specification, batch after batch.
reagent-manufacturing.lede: We manufacture enzyme mixes, master mixes, buffers, calibrators and controls under a documented quality system, with tight lot-to-lot consistency.
caps: Custom reagent production
Enzyme blends, PCR and isothermal master mixes, buffers and diluents made to your recipe.
Calibrators and controls
Matrix-matched materials with assigned values and stability data.
Raw material control
Qualified suppliers, incoming testing and full traceability for every component.
specBody: Reagents can ship as bulk liquid, filled vials or lyophilized beads and cakes.
Each lot is released against your functional and analytical specifications.
deliverables: Batch record and certificate of analysis

fill-finish.title: Fill and Finish
fill-finish.card: Aseptic filling of vials and containers, stoppering, capping and 100% inspection under Grade A conditions.
fill-finish.headline: Accurate fills in a protected aseptic environment.
fill-finish.lede: Isolator-based lines fill vials and containers, partially stopper them for lyophilization or fully seal liquid products, and inspect every unit.
caps: Aseptic filling
Peristaltic and piston pumps with in-process weight checks for precise doses.
Stoppering and capping
Partial stoppering for the lyophilizer, or full stoppering and crimp sealing for liquids.
Inspection
Every unit is inspected for particles, fill level and closure defects before release.
fill-finish.specTitle: Fill and finish at a glance
specBody: Media fills qualify every line configuration before your product runs on it.
Filled vials move directly from the isolator into the lyophilizer, with no transport between sites.
spec: Grade A isolator in Grade C background
13 mm and 20 mm stoppers and seals

lyophilization.title: Lyophilization
lyophilization.card: Cycle development, optimization and GMP lyophilization from pilot lots to commercial batches.
lyophilization.headline: Lyophilization is what we do best.
lyophilization.lede: We design cycles from your formulation's thermal data, scale them from pilot to production dryers, and run them under GMP with full process monitoring.
caps: Thermal characterization
Lyomicroscopy and DSC find your collapse and glass transition temperatures before any cycle is written.
Cycle development and optimization
We build a recipe that keeps product temperature below collapse, then shorten primary drying without risking the cake.
Scale-up and GMP manufacturing
Pilot and production dryers share controls and sensors, so a cycle transfers with predictable results.
specBody: Every dryer carries wireless product probes, capacitance and Pirani gauges, and pressure-rise testing to confirm the end of primary drying.
Controlled ice nucleation is available to make freezing uniform from vial to vial.
spec: Pilot 0.5 m², production 10 m² and 32 m²
deliverables: GMP batch record with full cycle data
Residual moisture and cake appearance results

kitting-packaging.title: Kitting and Packaging
kitting-packaging.card: Labeling, serialization, kit assembly and cartoning so finished product leaves ready for clinical or commercial use.
kitting-packaging.headline: Finished, labeled kits ready to ship.
kitting-packaging.lede: We label, serialize and assemble components into complete kits, with every label and insert checked against the approved artwork.
caps: Labeling and serialization
Printed and verified labels with lot, expiry and unique identifiers.
Kit assembly
Reagents, vials, devices and inserts packed into finished kits to your bill of materials.
Cartoning and shipping cases
Secondary packaging, inserts and case labels ready for distribution.
kitting-packaging.specTitle: Kitting and packaging at a glance
specBody: Line clearance and label reconciliation run on every packaging batch.
Cold-chain kits are assembled in temperature-controlled rooms.

storage-logistics.title: Storage and Logistics
storage-logistics.card: cGMP storage from −80 °C to room temperature, with monitored inventory and qualified shipping.
storage-logistics.headline: Storage and shipping that protect your product to the last mile.
storage-logistics.lede: Finished product, intermediates and retained samples are stored under monitored conditions and shipped in qualified packaging when you need them.
caps: cGMP storage
Freezers, cold rooms and controlled ambient space, all mapped and continuously monitored.
Inventory management
Every lot is tracked from receipt to release and shipment.
Distribution
Qualified shippers and couriers move product frozen, chilled or at room temperature.
storage-logistics.specTitle: Storage and logistics at a glance
specBody: Backup power and redundant units protect stored product during an outage.
Retained samples and stability pulls are managed under the same system.
spec: Chain of custody for every shipment

quality-control.title: Quality Control
quality-control.card: Analytical testing, release and stability programs that support every batch we make.
quality-control.headline: Testing that stands behind every batch.
quality-control.lede: Our quality control lab tests raw materials, in-process samples and finished product, and runs stability programs to support your shelf-life claims.
caps: Release testing
Identity, potency, purity, residual moisture and appearance against your specifications.
Method development and transfer
We build new methods or transfer and qualify yours.
Stability programs
Real-time and accelerated storage with scheduled pulls and trend reports.
specBody: Out-of-specification results are investigated under documented procedures and shared with you.
Data are recorded in validated systems that keep a full audit trail.
spec: HPLC, UV-Vis, qPCR, ELISA, enzyme activity

combination-products.title: Combination Product Manufacturing
combination-products.card: Manufacturing for products that pair a drug or biologic with a device, under one quality system.
combination-products.headline: Drug and device, built together.
combination-products.lede: We manufacture and assemble products that combine a drug or biologic with a delivery device, applying both drug and device quality requirements.
caps: Integrated manufacturing
Formulation, filling and device assembly planned as one process.
Device assembly
Prefilled components, cartridges and kits assembled in controlled areas.
Dual compliance
Records meet both drug cGMP and device design-control expectations.
specBody: Risk management follows the product from design transfer through commercial supply.
Functional testing confirms the device delivers the dose it should.
deliverables: Combined batch and device history record

tech-transfer.title: Technical Transfer
tech-transfer.card: Structured transfer of your process and methods into our facility, with gap analysis and engineering runs.
tech-transfer.headline: Move your process once, and move it right.
tech-transfer.lede: We take over processes from your lab or another manufacturer with a documented plan, gap analysis and engineering runs before any GMP batch.
caps: Gap analysis
We compare your process, equipment and methods with ours and resolve the differences up front.
Engineering runs
Trial batches confirm the process performs on our equipment before GMP manufacturing.
Method transfer
Analytical methods are transferred and qualified alongside the process.
specBody: A single project manager keeps the plan, risks and timeline visible to both teams.
Transfer reports document every change so regulators can follow the process history.
